menu.title: Choose & Enjoy
menu.description: Pick your favorite from our signature kebabs and burgers. Every ingredient carefully selected, every bite pure pleasure. Order in or get it delivered – quality is never compromised here.

items.1: Classic kebab in a crispy bun, with lettuce, tomato and our signature garlic sauce. A tried-and-true recipe that never disappoints.
items.2: Double meat, double melted cheese and spicy jalapeños – for those who like it intense. Definitely not for the faint-hearted!
items.3: Freshly grilled vegetables, creamy hummus and aromatic herbs. A light yet satisfying option for true food lovers.
items.4: Extra-hot chili, crispy onion rings and smoky BBQ sauce. A classic kebab with a bold, fiery twist.
items.5: Juicy meat marinated for 24 hours, with grilled peppers and a refreshing mint yogurt sauce. Turkish flavor in every single bite.
items.6: Crispy chicken instead of traditional meat, served with coleslaw and spicy mayo. A lighter alternative that still wows on taste.

footer.about: We are a place where traditional Turkish cuisine meets modern flavors. Our kebab is more than food – it is a journey through the aromas of Anatolia, crafted with passion and the freshest ingredients. Visit us and taste the difference.

events.slide1desc: We regularly host themed evenings, tastings and family-friendly events. Check our calendar and book your spot today – seats fill up fast and there is always something exciting going on!
events.slide2desc: Every week our chef prepares new specials using fresh, seasonal and locally sourced ingredients. Discover a menu that evolves with the seasons – a taste that always surprises.
